ladder.step: Ask for feedback and raise the concern informally
ladder.who: Named contact on the job advert or the recruiting team
ladder.when: As soon as possible after the decision
ladder.time_limit: None in law; tribunal clock runs from the act

ladder.step: Formal complaint to the recruiting department
ladder.who: Department or agency, using the complaints steps in the job advert
ladder.when: Promptly; get a final written response

ladder.who: Department's data protection team (subject access request)

ladder.step: Complaint to the Civil Service Commission (Recruitment Principles)
ladder.who: Civil Service Commission (not for the Northern Ireland Civil Service, most non-departmental public bodies, internal promotions, scores, feedback, vetting or offer withdrawal)
ladder.time_limit: Competition concluded in the past 12 months

ladder.who: Acas helpline, EASS (Great Britain), Citizens Advice, Law Centre, union; in Northern Ireland the Labour Relations Agency, Equality Commission or Advice NI

ladder.time_limit: Must notify within the tribunal limit; GB conciliation up to 12 weeks; NI deadline paused for up to 1 month

ladder.step: Tribunal claim against the potential employer
ladder.who: Employment tribunal (GB); Industrial or Fair Employment Tribunal (NI)
ladder.time_limit: GB: 6 months minus 1 day for acts from 1 October 2026 (3 months minus 1 day before); NI: usually 3 months

ladder_work.who: Line manager, HR or someone senior
ladder_work.time_limit: None in law; tribunal clock runs from the act

ladder_work.who: A manager not the subject of the grievance, under the grievance or bullying, harassment and discrimination policy
Employer, with a colleague or trade union representative accompanying you
ladder_work.when: Without unreasonable delay after the grievance
ladder_work.time_limit: If your companion cannot attend, you can propose another time up to 5 working days after the original date

ladder_work.step: Civil Service Code concern (only if a Code issue, not an HR matter)
ladder_work.who: Line management chain or nominated officers, then the Civil Service Commission; NICS Commissioners in Northern Ireland
ladder_work.when: After the Raising a Concern procedure

ladder_work.who: Acas helpline, EASS (Great Britain), union, Citizens Advice, Law Centre; in Northern Ireland the Labour Relations Agency or Advice NI

ladder_work.time_limit: Must notify within the tribunal limit; at least 1 month after the certificate to claim

ladder_work.who: Employment tribunal (GB); Industrial or Fair Employment Tribunal (NI)
ladder_work.time_limit: GB: 6 months minus 1 day for acts from 1 October 2026 (3 months minus 1 day before); NI: usually 3 months
